examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The band as the Application Accelerator page places it: the overline, the left-aligned headline and its supporting sentence, then six icon-led use cases in a three-column divider grid, each linking out to the page that explains it. Edit the props in the Controls panel — a band with no items renders nothing at all.
